rubric_items.reason: All 11 design components (CO-1 to CO-11) have at least one threat, and the names match the design one for one.
Most threats are specific to this change: the unbounded count, tampering with the started value, and PII in the list. T-3 and T-11 are generic and are more about reliability than security.

The mitigations cite verified controls or are named as new controls, and F-1 and F-2 are fixed. But T-4 and T-13 call the validation of started an existing control, while the design makes it a change.
The MVP auth gap, the accepted risks (T-2, T-10) and the missing rule for test data are all stated openly. No questions were needed.
Threats are now listed by risk, highest first, the new controls are listed up front, and the front matter matches the body.
